title: Iterative Launch Mesh for Runtime/Console/API
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Goal: Create an operational pattern (the 'Iterative Launch Mesh') that coordinates phased releases across Runtime, Console, and API surfaces to reduce cross-surface regressions, accelerate safe rollout, and provide deterministic cutover gates. Scope includes: launch calendar mesh design, signal definitions, automated gating criteria, rollback/playback paths, runbook templates, and a lightweight coordinator dashboard for PM/Eng leads. Out of scope: full automation of deploys or infra changes that require infra-only approvals (those will be integrated as separate tasks).

Success metrics: 1) Reduce cross-service incident rate during launches by 40% vs baseline; 2) Mean time to detect cross-surface rollback signal < 12 minutes during canary; 3) 90% of runtime+console+api launches follow the mesh checklist and publish preflight results; 4) Stakeholder satisfaction (survey) >= 4/5 for launch clarity.

Deliverables: 1) Mesh design doc + runbook; 2) Launch coordinator dashboard mock in Console; 3) Pull request templates and preflight checklist; 4) Pilot on 2 releases (one runtime-anchored, one console-anchored); 5) Postmortem template and telemetry dashboards to measure guardrail efficacy.

Stakeholders: Product (Aisha), Runtime Eng (Priya Raman), Console Eng (Ethan Park), API Platform (Lena Gomez), Reliability (Samir Desai), DevEx (Nadia Ortiz), Security (Compliance team).
acceptance_criteria: Design doc reviewed and signed off by Runtime, Console, and API leads
Coordinator dashboard mock accepted by Console PM and UX
Checklist automation added to release repository (preflight CI job) and executed in pilot
Two pilot launches completed with documented preflight results and one post-pilot retro
Telemetry dashboard shows pre/post comparison for incident rate and detection latency
rollout_phases: Phase 0 - Align: stakeholder workshop, inventory of previous cross-surface regressions (2 weeks)
Phase 1 - Design & Runbook: produce design doc, gating criteria, and runbook (3 weeks)
Phase 2 - Pilot Build: dashboard mock + checklist automation + pilot repo integration (4 weeks)
Phase 3 - Pilot Execution: run two pilots across different anchors, collect telemetry (2 weeks)
Phase 4 - Iterate & Scale: incorporate feedback, automate two gating checks, and hand off to release ops (4 weeks)
risks: Insufficient telemetry alignment between teams — may delay detecting cross-surface regressions
Resource contention during busy quarter — pilots may slip if runtime capacity work spikes
Overly prescriptive gating could slow high-priority launches — need escape hatches
Dashboard scope creep if teams expect full orchestration rather than coordinator views
